title: kid derivation
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1; HCERT Specification, A.1 The Key Identifier (`kid`s).

statements.label: kid derivation
statements.requirement: kid SHALL be the first 8 bytes of SHA-256 over the DER-encoded DSC. The issuer SHALL derive it from the Signer's DSC, not take it from the caller.

successCriteria.criterion: PR 129 example as a conformance vector (req:stt-tst-001) passes.

sources.quote: take the DER encoding of the DSC and use the first 8 bytes of its SHA-256 fingerprint
